d:
"Tum Saaz Chhedo Main Geet Gaaoon" is a soft, melodious love song built on the idea of two people making music together. From "Dil Ki Baazi" (1993), it is sung by the legendary Lata Mangeshkar, with Akshay Kumar and Ayesha Jhulka bringing the song's tender romance to life on screen.

Song: Tum Saaz Chhedo Main Geet Gaaoon
Movie: Dil Ki Baazi (1993)

Singer: Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director: Ram-Laxman
Lyricist: Ravindra Rawal
